figures.explanation: This loop skips scholarships when applications are blocked, when the enabled/open flags fail the shown condition, or when the student's GWA is missing or exceeds the required minimum. A missing scholarship GWA requirement is resolved using the provider policy; these are recommendation-stage filters, not the complete application-approval checks.

figures.title: Weighted Recommendation Scoring
figures.explanation: The code adds GWA fit, roster popularity, location fit and a fixed completeness component with an image bonus to obtain one ranking score. The location calculation is delegated to _location_score; the high-grade flag and maximum roster denominator are prepared earlier on lines 141-143 and are explained in Section C.
